_meta.nondeterminism: Three things differ between two captures of the same Carbon and none is a defect. React useId values (aria-describedby=...-_r_3_ vs _r_0_) churn every run -- 46 of 66 differing stories on 2026-08-31 were nothing else. Popover auto-align picks a placement from position, so --open can become --left. And date-dependent content moves: the datepicker aria-current=date crossed from 30 to 31 August at midnight, mid-capture-session. Compare captures with those normalised or the diff is unreadable.
